2023 
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 86 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 41889 of 2022 Applicant :- Deepak Mishra Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Bharti,Sandeep Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No.181of 2021,
under Sections 452, 376-D 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and under Section 3(2)(V) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Police Station Koraon, District Prayagraj with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted that the victim in the statement under Section 161 CrPC did not mention the name of the applicant.
It is further submitted that the complainant in her statement recorded under Section 164 CrPC stated that two unknown persons committed offence.

The name of the present applicant was not mentioned in her statement, thereafter additional statement of the victim was recorded by the Investigating Officer in which she named the present applicant for the first time.
It is submitted that the evidentiary value of the statement recorded under Section 164 has a greater value than the additional statement recorded by the Investigating Officer.

It is further submitted that the uncle of the applicant had moved application Deepak Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44406758/
1 dated 09.10.2018 and 09.03.2021 with the authorities that the father of the victim wanted to encroach their land.

entities.text: Deepak Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that no adverse finding recorded in the FSL Report.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 03.06.2022 and have one criminal history which is explained in supplementary affidavit filed today and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and argued that the date of birth of the victim is 01.07.2004 but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspect of the matter.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Deepak Mishra in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2).
The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 19.1.2023 VK Bharteey  Deepak Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44406758/
